import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive visualization
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))
fig.suptitle('Dog Registration Analysis in Zurich, Switzerland', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# 1. Top 10 Dog Breeds
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
# Get the most recent year's data to avoid counting same dogs multiple times
latest_year = df['StichtagDatJahr'].max()
df_latest = df[df['StichtagDatJahr'] == latest_year]

breed_counts = df_latest['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().head(10)
colors = sns.color_palette('viridis', 10)
bars1 = ax1.barh(breed_counts.index[::-1], breed_counts.values[::-1], color=colors)
ax1.set_xlabel('Number of Dogs')
ax1.set_ylabel('Breed')
ax1.set_title(f'Top 10 Dog Breeds in Zurich ({latest_year})')
for bar, value in zip(bars1, breed_counts.values[::-1]):
    ax1.text(value + 20, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2, str(value), va='center', fontsize=9)

# 2. Dog Age Distribution
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
# Filter out invalid ages and get age distribution
age_order = df_latest.sort_values('AlterVHundSort')['AlterVHundLang'].unique()
age_counts = df_latest['AlterVHundLang'].value_counts()
age_counts = age_counts.reindex([a for a in age_order if a in age_counts.index])

colors2 = sns.color_palette('coolwarm', len(age_counts))
ax2.bar(range(len(age_counts)), age_counts.values, color=colors2)
ax2.set_xticks(range(len(age_counts)))
ax2.set_xticklabels(age_counts.index, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=8)
ax2.set_xlabel('Dog Age Category')
ax2.set_ylabel('Number of Dogs')
ax2.set_title(f'Dog Age Distribution ({latest_year})')

# 3. Dogs by District (Kreis)
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
district_counts = df_latest.groupby('KreisLang')['AnzHunde'].sum().sort_values(ascending=True)
colors3 = sns.color_palette('mako', len(district_counts))
bars3 = ax3.barh(district_counts.index, district_counts.values, color=colors3)
ax3.set_xlabel('Number of Dogs')
ax3.set_ylabel('District')
ax3.set_title(f'Dog Population by District ({latest_year})')
for bar, value in zip(bars3, district_counts.values):
    ax3.text(value + 10, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2, str(value), va='center', fontsize=8)

# 4. Dog Gender Distribution with Owner Gender breakdown
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
# Create a crosstab of dog gender and owner gender
gender_cross = pd.crosstab(df_latest['SexHundLang'], df_latest['SexLang'])
gender_cross.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax4, color=['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4'], width=0.7)
ax4.set_xlabel('Dog Gender')
ax4.set_ylabel('Number of Dogs')
ax4.set_title(f'Dog Gender by Owner Gender ({latest_year})')
ax4.set_xticklabels(ax4.get_xticklabels(), rotation=0)
ax4.legend(title='Owner Gender')

# Add counts on bars
for container in ax4.containers:
    ax4.bar_label(container, fontsize=9)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
